description: This file defines the CanvasWindowController class, which manages a macOS window with a WebKit web view for rendering Canvas content. It handles initialization, configuration, loading URLs/files, JavaScript evaluation, snapshots, and communication between JavaScript and native code.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller for a window displaying a WebKit view, handling loading, navigation, messages, and debug status for a Canvas application.

methods.name: init(sessionKey:root:presentation:)
methods.description: Initializes the CanvasWindowController with a session key, root URL, and presentation configuration.

methods.name: applyPreferredPlacement(_:)
methods.description: Sets the preferred placement of the window.

methods.name: showCanvas(path:)
methods.description: Displays the window and loads the specified path or URL.

methods.name: load(target:)
methods.description: Loads a URL, file, or route into the web view based on the target string.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus(enabled:title:subtitle:)
methods.description: Updates the debug status display on the web view.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded()
methods.description: Applies the current debug status to the web view via JavaScript.

methods.name: loadFile(_:)
methods.description: Loads a local file URL into the web view.

methods.name: eval(javaScript:)
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the web view and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshot(to:)
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the web view and saves it to a file.

methods.name: directoryPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the session directory.

methods.name: shouldAutoNavigateToA2UI(lastAutoTarget:)
methods.description: Determines if auto-navigation to A2UI should occur based on the current and last target.
